completeness.why: Every site takes the hidden/hidden-group/income-in-tracking decision from isMonthFillCategory (setZero via an explicit includeHidden: true, the preserved inconsistency), the three averages share getAverageFillCategories, and both sign inversions go through getAverageBudgetAmount; the SQL no longer filters hidden rows itself, only the join type (INNER for averages) still encodes the unchecked missing-group difference.

interface.why: A small predicate with one named includeHidden option for the real setZero variation and a separate sign helper; the missing-group inconsistency is carried implicitly by INNER vs LEFT JOIN in two queries rather than being explicit, and setZero/getAverageFillCategories repeat the same SELECT.

disguised_duplication.where: setZero and getAverageFillCategories carry the same category SELECT, differing only in LEFT vs INNER JOIN, instead of one query with the join choice made explicit.
